Cycle Center Sunday Morning Ride

Columbia, SC · Five Points · Road

Cycle Center Sunday Morning Ride is a road group ride in Columbia, SC. It rolls every Sunday at 9:00 am from Cycle Center. About 22–40 miles.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at @cyclecenter_sc the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Cycle Center Sunday Morning Ride group ride

A Sunday road ride from the Five Points shop. Loops run into Cayce and West Columbia. Distance depends on who shows up. The shop also lists a Friday evening ride in season.
